notes: Checks run from the repo root. A check that runs its work in a container or on another host (docker exec, kubectl exec, ssh) needs a 'cleanup' command: a check killed at the gate cap takes only its local client with it, so the gate runs 'cleanup' after a timeout, with the same $MYSPEC_CHECK_RUN_ID the check saw. Have the check record its remote PID in a file named after $MYSPEC_CHECK_RUN_ID, and have 'cleanup' kill that PID's process group. Give a check a non-empty 'diffCommand' when its plain 'command' already fails on the default branch: the gate runs 'diffCommand' instead, with $MYSPEC_BASE_REF exported as the merge base with the default branch. Scope the command to that range and guard it against an empty file set, e.g. files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR $MYSPEC_BASE_REF -- '*.ts'); [ -z "$files" ] || npx eslint $files
